metrics.definition: Inverse false-invalidation rate so higher remains better in this fixture.

conditions.manipulation_check: Observed input hash and baseline read-back match the preregistration.

conditions.intervention: Derange real cross-references while retaining the baseline surface.
conditions.expected_behavior: Semantic acceptance degrades without a provenance marker.
conditions.manipulation_check: The derangement changes cross-reference coherence while surface dimensions remain paired.

conditions.intervention: Expose a directly labeled known outcome.
conditions.expected_behavior: The instrument resolves a larger effect than the treatment.
conditions.manipulation_check: Known-outcome identifiers are present in the scored artifact.

conditions.expected_behavior: The primary outcome improves over baseline by at least the MDE where supported.
conditions.manipulation_check: The resulting artifact carries Amanuensis run and projection custody.

conditions.intervention: Run the workflow without persistent conspectus context.
conditions.expected_behavior: Any benefit attributable to the conspectus diminishes.
conditions.manipulation_check: The input manifest omits conspectus references.

conditions.intervention: Repeat the treatment on byte-identical pinned input.
conditions.expected_behavior: Critical outcomes remain stable within the preregistered step and MDE.
conditions.manipulation_check: Input hash matches treatment and the replicate identifier remains distinct.

conditions.expected_behavior: Outcome does not degrade relative to treatment.
conditions.manipulation_check: The added context IDs are present in the compiled input.

conditions.expected_behavior: Outcome does not improve relative to treatment.
conditions.manipulation_check: The removed context ID is absent from the compiled input.

stopping_rules: Land exactly every preregistered case before deriving any envelope.
Treat a failed delivery, inert determinism control, or no-headroom observation as instrument-undetermined.
Never publish a pooled efficacy statistic.

operational_framing.detected: A known outcome is named at the correct locus with supporting evidence.
operational_framing.missed: A known outcome was available to the assigned condition but absent from its result.
operational_framing.unknown: The evidence cannot discriminate detection from absence without inventing authority.
